text: In Germany, if you are too sick or injured to work, you take a sick day. This guide explains how sick leave works.

section: It’s okay to take sick days
text: On average, German employees take 20 sick days per year. You can take as many sick days as you need. During your probation period, your employer can fire you without a reason. You can take sick days, but if you take too many, you could get fired. After your probation period, your employer can’t punish you because you take sick days. If you take more than 30 sick days per year, you could get fired. To fire you, your employer must prove that you will not get better, that it’s bad for the company, and that there are no other options (like a transfer or reduced hours). [§ 167 SGB IX (May 2026)] If you take sick days when you are not sick, you can get fired. For example, if you say that are too sick to work, but you go clubbing, you can get fired.

section: What to do when you are sick
title: 1. Tell your team
text: Tell your employer and your team that you are sick as soon as you can. Each team has different rules for this. Usually, you just need to call, email or message your manager.

section: What to do when you are sick
title: 2. Get a sick note from a doctor
text: Most employers ask for a sick note if you are sick for more than 3 days. Some ask for a sick note on the first day that you are sick. In the first month of your probation period, get a sick note on the first day. You get a sick note from a Hausarzt. You can get it in person, with a phone call, or with a video call. You can use an app like TeleClinic or Doktor.de instead of visiting a doctor. It’s faster and easier. English-speaking doctors in Berlin You can also get a sick note for stress, depression, burnout, lack of sleep, and other mental health reasons. If you have public health insurance, the doctor visit is free. If you have private or expat health insurance, the cost depends on what your insurance covers, and on your deductible. A short doctor visit without insurance costs around € 60.

section: What to do when you are sick
title: 3. Send the sick note to your employer
text: Since 2023, you don’t need to give a sick note to your employer. Your employer can get a digital sick note from your health insurer.

section: What to do when you are sick
title: 4. Get better
text: If you have a sick note, you have the right to go on sick leave. Your employer can’t refuse. When you are on sick leave, you do not have to do any work. You don’t have to join meetings, answer emails, or be online. Your employer must leave you alone, except if they have urgent questions. The goal of sick leave is to get better, and go back to work when you are healthy.

section: You still get paid when you are sick
title: The first 6 weeks
text: For the first 42 days of your sick leave, your employer pays your full salary. You get paid for the days that you are supposed to work. If you do something really dangerous and you get hurt, you get unpaid sick leave. For example, you don’t get paid sick leave for kickboxing, motorcycle racing or drunk driving injuries. You don’t get paid sick leave for tattoos or plastic surgery.

section: You still get paid when you are sick
title: The next 78 weeks
text: After 6 weeks, your employer stops paying you. Instead, you get Krankengeld from your public health insurance. It’s 70% of your gross salary, up to € 135.62 per day. [§ 47 SGB V, tk.de] Krankengeld calculator (in German) – Techniker Krankenkasse Krankengeld calculator – Arbeitnow You do not get Krankengeld if… You have private health insurance (you need Krankentagegeld insurance) You have expat health insurance You have a minijob You have free health insurance ( Familienversicherung) You have student health insurance You are self-employed (you must pay a little more for it)

section: You still get paid when you are sick
title: After that
text: You can get Krankengeld for 78 weeks every 3 years. After 6 weeks of sick pay and 78 weeks of Krankengeld, you must go to the Agentur für Arbeit, and apply for disability benefits. Two things can happen: Temporary sickness: unemployment benefits You get unemployment benefits for the disabled ( Arbeitslosengeld bei Arbeitsunfähigkeit) until you get better. You will get very little money – about € 835 per month. Permanent disability: public pension If you can’t work again, you get a pension for the disabled ( Erwerbsminderungsrente). If you paid public pension contributions for less than 60 months, you can’t get a pension. If you have a mortgage, or if your family depends on you, get disability insurance. It gives you an income if you are too sick or disabled to work. What is disability insurance?

section: Things you can do on sick leave
text: When you are on sick leave, you don’t have to stay at home. You can still do things that don’t hurt your recovery. If you can’t work because of an injury, you can still meet friends, go shopping and travel. For example, if you can’t work because of a broken arm, you can still have coffee with a friend. It does not hurt your recovery. If you can’t work because you are sick, you can still travel if it helps your recovery. For example, you can go to the Baltic Sea to get rest and fresh air. If you can’t work because of depression or burnout, you can do things that make you feel better.
If you are self-employed, you do not get paid sick leave. If you are too sick to work, you have no income. You must prepare for this.

title: How to protect yourself
text: If you have public health insurance You can pay more for Krankengeld. It costs 0.6% of your income. You get Krankengeld after 6 weeks of sick leave, but you can pay more to get it faster ( Krankengeld Wahltarif). If you have private health insurance You can pay for Krankentagegeld. It pays you while you are too sick to work. You can also get job disability insurance ( Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung). It pays you if you are permanently unable to do your job. If you have a family or a mortgage, this is important. Around 26% of Germans have disability insurance. It costs around € 40 per month. Feather and Getsafe sell disability insurance, and they speak English. Tarifcheck helps you compare options, but it’s only in German. In your contracts, define what happens if you are too sick to finish a project in time.
If you have public health insurance, and you pay the cheaper student tariff, you do not get Krankengeld. If you are too sick to work, you have no income.

If you get ALG I, your job is to look for work. If you are sick, and you can’t look for work, you must get a sick note for the Agentur für Arbeit. When you are healthy again, you must tell the Agentur für Arbeit. While you are sick, you keep getting unemployment benefits for the first 6 weeks. After 6 weeks, you get Krankengeld from your public health insurance. How unemployment benefits work

title: If you are sick while on vacation
text: If you are on vacation, you can still get sick leave. The days you are on sick leave do not count as vacations. [haufe.de, § 9 BUrlG] For example, if you take a 10-day vacation, and you are sick for 4 days during the vacation, you only use 6 vacation days. Your vacation ends and your sick leave starts when you get a sick note from the doctor. If you are sick during your vacation, get a sick note as soon as you can.

title: If you have a hangover
text: If you have a hangover, you can take an unpaid sick day. You don’t get paid because the hangover is your fault. Since you don’t need to explain why you are sick, you usually get a paid sick day. Missing work because of a hangover looks really bad. If it happens often, you can get fired. If you go to work while you are not sober, you can get fired.

title: During your notice period
text: If you quit or lose your job, and you are in your notice period, you can still take sick days. You still get paid while on sick leave. How the notice period works
